tutorialStep1Content.message: Your digital companion for responsible gaming. I help you stay in control while browsing.

tutorialStep2Content.message: This is Breathy, your digital mascot. Its emotions reflect your playing time: happy when all is well, tired at half your limit, and alert when you go over it.

tutorialStep3Content.message: Automatically detects betting sites and online casinos. No setup needed, it works immediately.

tutorialStep4Content.message: Click on Breathy at any time to do a guided breathing exercise and stay calm.

tutorialStep5Content.message: Set your session time limit. Breathy will gently remind you as you approach it.

tutorialStep6Content.message: Click the Breathy icon in the toolbar to access settings and your current session.

tutorialStep7Content.message: All your data is stored locally in your browser. Breathy doesn't send information to external servers.

tutorialStep8Content.message: You now know the basics. Breathy will be here to support you on your journey to more conscious and responsible gaming.

realityCheck1.message: How are you feeling right now? Remember, you can take a break anytime.

realityCheck2.message: Are you only gambling with money you can afford to lose?

realityCheck3.message: Pause and take a deep breath. Your well-being comes first.

realityCheck4.message: Games are designed to make you feel close to winning. Don't be fooled.

realityCheck5.message: Remember: gambling is for fun, not for making money.

realityCheck6.message: How long have you been playing? Time can slip away quickly.

realityCheck7.message: Ask yourself: do you need this money for something important?

realityCheck8.message: Do you feel in control of your gambling choices?

realityCheck9.message: Did you have other plans today? Don't let gambling make you lose track of time.

realityCheck10.message: Before you continue, make sure you've set a clear loss limit.

realityCheck11.message: There's no guaranteed strategy: luck always wins in the end.

realityCheck12.message: If you're gambling to feel better, it might be time to pause and take care of yourself.

realityCheck13.message: If any result made you feel bad today, that's a sign to take a break.

realityCheck14.message: Trying to win back losses often leads to losing even more.

realityCheck15.message: Gambling should never interfere with your responsibilities or daily life.
